versions.changelog:
Initial release of tilda-publisher.

- Publish and manage articles on Tilda website builder using browser automation (Playwright).
- Supports creating new articles, editing existing pages, and publishing drafts.
- Onboarding flow guides users to set up Tilda credentials and environment variables.
- Automatically installs Playwright if missing and saves credentials locally.
- Handles login, project selection, and content publishing steps via browser automation.
- Returns live URLs after publishing actions.
